top_choice_rationale: The B003 prize to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov rests on a mature, independently replicated chain from incretin physiology and proglucagon processing to the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide and on to therapies with large randomized-trial effects on glycaemia, weight and cardiovascular and renal outcomes. A citation framed around the physiology and the active form, with the therapies named as the consequence, makes three names a coherent allocation. The attribution questions (Knudsen's analogues, Mojsov's priority against Habener) are real but concern credit, not merit or maturity, and do not justify withholding the prize.
